Messages.Author: Fede
Messages.Body:
1) Can Taste of Vitae be used to gain blood from ALL the strikes made in one
round, or only from one strike in the strike resolution step?

2) If I play Trap, can I cancel later my mandatory press with an optional
press to avoid second round of combat?

Thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Fede wrote:
>
> 1) Can Taste of Vitae be used to gain blood from ALL the strikes made in one
> round, or only from one strike in the strike resolution step?

All strikes that have already occured in the round.

> 2) If I play Trap, can I cancel later my mandatory press with an optional
> press to avoid second round of combat?

Yes, you can cancel the Trap's press. The Trap's press is not "your" press.

Messages.Author: skaffen_amtiskaw
Messages.Body:
"Fede" <federi...@libero.it> wrote in article
<1Ynp6.108542$Y93.2...@news.infostrada.it> :

>1) Can Taste of Vitae be used to gain blood from ALL the strikes made in one
>round, or only from one strike in the strike resolution step?
>

Card Text:
Taste Of Vitae, Combat
Only usable after strike resolution. This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the opposing vampire to damage during this round of combat. Not usable by a vampire going to torpor. Blood loss counted by a previous Taste of Vitae is not counted again.

You can use Taste after the last strike resolution in any given round, so if there where multiple strikes due to cards like Blur, you can taste the full amount of blood lost by your opponent from all strikes that round.

>2) If I play Trap, can I cancel later my mandatory press with an optional
>press to avoid second round of combat?
>

Card Text:
Trap, Combat
Only usable before range is determined on the first round. During the press step, if any Methuselah has played a card earlier in the current round or durin the two previous rounds, the Trap automatically provides a press to continue (either combatant can press to end).

So yes, by card text.
